From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Kate Lin <kate@silverlinehealth.com>, procurement@silverlinehealth.com
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Silverline Health — pre-handoff summary, scope & suggested kickoff window

Hi team,

Quick handoff note for Silverline (see Deal SL-2027-0421): they signed on 4/12, committed to a June 1 pilot go-live (internal target), and have a small PHI ingestion pipeline we need to validate. Short summary:

- Contract: 12-month SaaS + reserved capacity (Committed 8 vGPU-hours/day).
- Initial scope: embeddings + few-shot reranking for triage workflows.
- Data residency requirement: US-only (AWS us-west-2).
- Security asks: they requested SOC 2 in three weeks and an export of audit-logging examples.
- Billing/pricing: procurement will route PO; expect DocuSign SOW to be signed this week (cc'd procurement).

Attachments: Silverline_SOW_v1.docx (attached), proposed kickoff checklist.

Please own the kickoff scheduling and the mutual action plan. Suggested kickoff window: Apr 20–22 (we're tight, but they want an early alignment).

Risks/asks for CS/Implementation:
- Technical deep-dive required (networking/VPN & S3 access) before any staging data load.
- We should confirm whether they require an on-prem connector — assumed cloud-only for now.
- Point person for security evidence: Vanessa (ops), but procurement will need the final PDFs.

Vanessa — can you pick an implementation lead and a single CS owner? Monica/Tessa — heads up on the security lead time.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

--

Hi Kate — thanks for signing and for the quick turnaround. Welcome!

Ben: thanks for the summary — adding a few quick owner assignments and next steps.

Owners/roles (tentative):
- Implementation lead (staging / infra): Monica Patel (monica_patel@redwood.com)
- Customer Success lead (adoption / success plan): Tessa Morgan (tessa_morgan@redwood.com)
- Security/compliance request owner (evidence delivery): Vanessa Ortiz (me) — I will coordinate SOC2 artifacts and audit log extracts.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Kickoff meeting (45 min) — propose Tue Apr 20 at 10:00 AM PT. Monica will lead the technical portion; Tessa will run success milestones.
2) Security checklist: I'll send the SOC2 extracts and sample audit logs by EOD Fri 4/16.
3) DocuSign SOW: Ben/procurement, please confirm if the attached SOW needs any redlines; Monica will not begin staging until DocuSign + PO are in place.
4) Mutual Action Plan (MAP): I uploaded a draft MAP and kickoff deck — attachments: Silverline_Kickoff_Deck_v1.pdf and Silverline_SOW_v1.docx. Please review.

Kate — can you confirm the proposed kickoff time (Apr 20, 10 AM PT) and whether your engineering lead (for VPN / S3 creds) can join? If that slot doesn't work, propose two alternatives and we'll lock it.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Ops | Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: Silverline handoff — immediate tasks and risks (internal)

Monica / Tessa — internal-only follow-up. Reposting key asks and owners so we have a single checklist.

High-priority items before kickoff:
- Monica: schedule tech deep-dive (60m) with Silverline infra and our infra eng. Ask list: VPN type (client or site-to-site), S3 bucket naming + cross-account role, example data sample (size & schema), any on-prem connector requirement. Target: complete by Apr 19.
- Monica: confirm that our staging cluster in us-west-2 can be reserved (need ticket to infra to pin capacity for pilot).
- Tessa: draft 30/60/90 success milestones and a list of onboarding deliverables (training sessions, acceptance criteria, sample prompts to validate reranking). Put this in the MAP doc.
- Vanessa (me): collate SOC2 excerpts and an example of audit logs (obfuscate tokens). I'll share via secure Drive link by EOD Fri 4/16.

Risk flags (call these out during kickoff):
- Data residency enforcement may require a region-specific deployment plan beyond standard onboarding — if Silverline insists on strict controls, timeline could slip 3–4 weeks.
- Procurement timeline: if PO lags beyond 10 business days, we cannot start staging.

Action items and owners (quick):
- Monica: tech deep-dive invite + infra ticket (owner: monica_patel)
- Tessa: MAP update + success plan draft (owner: tessa_morgan)
- Ben: confirm DocuSign routing to procurement (owner: ben_carter)
- Vanessa: SOC2 artifacts + kickoff deck finalization (owner: vanessa_ortiz)

Please confirm when invites are out. I'll join the tech deep-dive to represent compliance.

Thanks,
Vanessa
